title: Rounding-level rejections do not count as secant failures
notes: PRICE4B (4 line-search configs), BQPGASIM. 0/34 secant_recovery_premature. Needed two guards after MATRIX2 became a false success: QP-optimality shortcut keeps its recovery gate; stationarity scale ignores multipliers of an unconverged QP.
